Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and the next steps we agreed on: 

Summary of call:
- Pilot use case: internal support ticket summarization + routing pilot (10k tickets/month)
- Primary success metrics: 45% reduction in triage time, SLA improvements for P1 incidents
- Expected start: November pilot; goal for decision by end of Q4

Stakeholder map (notes from our conversation):
- You (Samantha) — champion / product owner (driving requirements)
- Mark Reynolds — Head of Procurement (formal PO + vendor onboarding)
- Security contact (TBD) — will want SOC 2, data residency and retention details
- Economic buyer: VP of Ops (final sign-off on spend)

Open items / next steps:
1) I will share a short ROI 1-pager and a draft mutual action plan by EOD tomorrow (attached).
2) Can you introduce me to Mark (procurement) and the security person? We need to confirm procurement timelines and any additional docs they require (SLA, MSA redlines, SCCs).
3) Rishi will prepare a short champion enablement deck (talk tracks + ROI bullets) and join the intro call with procurement if helpful.
4) Samantha — you mentioned the decision criteria favoring predictable unit cost and ability to private deploy later; can you confirm the top 3 criteria?

Attachments: Redwood-ROI-1-pager.pdf, Mutual_Action_Plan.docx

Thanks — appreciate the fast sync.

Best,

Hi all —

Quick note from procurement side: our typical timeline for new vendors is 4–6 weeks after we receive complete documentation. Required items we will need up front:
- Current SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 letter of intent + timeline)
- Standard vendor questionnaire (I attached the template)
- Sample MSA / redline window (our legal team prefers a 10-business-day review)
- Invoice/PO process and remittance details

Marissa — please send the SOC 2 artifact or status and the completed questionnaire. If you have an initial MSA and mutual action plan that outlines milestones (pilot start, go/no-go decision, billing cadence), that will help expedite review.

I can target an initial vendor review on Oct 1 if we have docs by Sept 20.
